adminErasure.pageSubtitle: Permanently erase a data subject's personal data across all collections. This action is irreversible.
adminErasure.idle: Search a lead or agent to begin an erasure request.
adminErasure.searchPlaceholder: Search by lead ID or agent UID…
adminErasure.blastRadiusHint: Read-only count of records that will be deleted. No data has been changed.
adminErasure.confirmBody: This permanently deletes {ref}'s personal data across all collections (conversations, messages, lead context, reply edits, escalations, knowledge gaps, profile, storage). This cannot be undone. The audit log is retained (hashes only) as the legal record that erasure occurred.

adminErasure.requestQueued: Erasure request queued. The sweep will complete remaining batches within 72 hours.
adminErasure.statusPending: Queued — the sweep will complete remaining batches.
adminErasure.statusInProgress: In progress — sweep is processing batches.
adminErasure.auditRetainedNote: The audit log (hashes only) is retained as the legal record that erasure occurred.
